ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Sysinternals Sdelete Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of a renamed SysInternals Sdelete, which is something an administrator shouldn't do (the renaming)

sequences.query: process_original_file_name = "sdelete\.exe" AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\sdelete\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sdelete64\\\.exe$")))
